segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Publisher: Uses a timer to emit the date once per second. let timerPub = Timer.publish(every: 1, on: .main, in: .default) .autoconnect() // Subscriber: Waits 5 seconds after subscription, then requests a // maximum of 3 values. class MySubscriber: Subscriber { typealias Input = Date typealias Failure = Never var subscription: Subscription? func receive(subscription: Subscription) { print("published received") self.subscription = subscription DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 5) { subscription.request(.max(3)) } } func receive(_ input: Date) -> Subscribers.Demand { print("\(input) \(Date())") return Subscribers.Demand.none } func receive(completion: Subscribers.Completion<Never>) { print ("--done--") } } // Subscribe to timerPub. let mySub = MySubscriber() print ("Subscribing at \(Date())") timerPub.subscribe(mySub) ```
